# Escrcpy 📱 Display and control your Android device graphically with scrcpy. [中文文档](https://github.com/viarotel-org/escrcpy/blob/main/README-CN.md)
Escrcpy focuses on a stable integration foundation; some advanced features come from the private extension repository EscrcpyX and are offered on a paid basis. ## Features - 🖥️ **Inset Mirror**: Dedicated embedded window, auto-fits screen resolution and orientation, with integrated one-tap shortcuts - ⌨️ **Keyboard Mapping**: Configure touch, joystick, swipe, scroll, and automation mappings directly on the embedded mirror - 🔄 **Multi-Device Control**: Control multiple devices simultaneously in a single window, broadcast input, with batch screenshot and APK install support - 🎛️ **Integrated Control Bar**: Compact, draggable sidebar with reorderable controls: rotation, screenshot, apps, files, terminal, AI assistant, and automation - 🤖 **Copilot**: AI assistant built on MCP protocol for intelligent Android device control with multi-model chat support - 🏃 **Automation Script**: Visual step-by-step workflow orchestration with screen image recognition and batch execution across multiple devices - 🪟 **Multi-Device Management**: Visual window orchestration for centralized management of all connected devices - 📡 **Wireless Connection**: Wireless ADB connections with LAN auto-discovery and Gnirehtet reverse tethering support - 🔑 **Shortcut Management**: Customizable global hotkeys for quick device operations - ⚡ **Scrcpy Core**: High-performance, low-latency screen mirroring and control ## Installation ### Manual Installation via Released Packages Check the [Releases Page](https://github.com/viarotel-org/escrcpy/releases) ### macOS Installation via Homebrew Refer to [homebrew-escrcpy](https://github.com/viarotel-org/homebrew-escrcpy) ## Documentation - [Getting Started](https://viarotel.eu.org/guide/started) - [Shortcuts](https://viarotel.eu.org/reference/scrcpy/shortcuts) - [Device Operations](https://viarotel.eu.org/guide/operation) - [Preferences](https://viarotel.eu.org/guide/preferences) - [FAQ](https://viarotel.eu.org/help/escrcpy) - [Report Issues](https://github.com/viarotel-org/escrcpy/issues) - [Contact Email](mailto:viarotel@qq.com) ## What's Next? [Milestones](https://viarotel.eu.org/guide/milestones) ## Acknowledgments This project owes its existence to the following open-source projects: - [scrcpy](https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy) - [adbkit](https://github.com/DeviceFarmer/adbkit) - [electron](https://www.electronjs.org/) - [vue](https://vuejs.org/) - [gnirehtet](https://github.com/Genymobile/gnirehtet/) - [yadb](https://github.com/nicepkg/yadb) - [tangoadb](https://tangoadb.dev/) ## Friendly Links - [ADB Device Manager 2](https://github.com/Shrey113/Adb-Device-Manager-2) ## Donate If this project has helped you, consider buying me a coffee to keep me motivated for further improvements 😛

Escrcpy

📱 Display and control your Android device graphically with scrcpy. 中文文档

Escrcpy focuses on a stable integration foundation; some advanced features come from the private extension repository EscrcpyX and are offered on a paid basis.

Features

  • 🖥️ Inset Mirror: Dedicated embedded window, auto-fits screen resolution and orientation, with integrated one-tap shortcuts
  • ⌨️ Keyboard Mapping: Configure touch, joystick, swipe, scroll, and automation mappings directly on the embedded mirror
  • 🔄 Multi-Device Control: Control multiple devices simultaneously in a single window, broadcast input, with batch screenshot and APK install support
  • 🎛️ Integrated Control Bar: Compact, draggable sidebar with reorderable controls: rotation, screenshot, apps, files, terminal, AI assistant, and automation
  • 🤖 Copilot: AI assistant built on MCP protocol for intelligent Android device control with multi-model chat support
  • 🏃 Automation Script: Visual step-by-step workflow orchestration with screen image recognition and batch execution across multiple devices
  • 🪟 Multi-Device Management: Visual window orchestration for centralized management of all connected devices
  • 📡 Wireless Connection: Wireless ADB connections with LAN auto-discovery and Gnirehtet reverse tethering support
  • 🔑 Shortcut Management: Customizable global hotkeys for quick device operations
  • ⚡ Scrcpy Core: High-performance, low-latency screen mirroring and control

# 🚀 Escrcpy 3.2.0 — Smoother Embedded Mirroring, Stronger Cross-Platform Support

Escrcpy 3.2.0 focuses on improving the **embedded mirroring experience, device control, cross-platform support, and AI Copilot**.

This release brings smoother embedded mirroring interactions, new **Always on Top** and **Fullscreen** features, more reliable keyboard and mouse mapping, and official **Linux ARM64** support. It also fixes several issues on Windows, including application launching and audio forwarding problems.

---

# ✨ Highlights

## 🖥️ A Major Upgrade to Embedded Mirroring

The embedded mirroring experience has been comprehensively optimized for better performance, responsiveness, and stability.

### 📌 New Always on Top

You can now keep the embedded mirroring window **above other windows**.

This is especially useful for device monitoring, remote control, and multi-device workflows, eliminating the need to constantly switch between windows.

Embedded mirroring now supports quickly entering **fullscreen mode**, giving you a larger display area for the mirrored device.

releases.body: # 🚀 Escrcpy 3.0.8 — Smarter Device Control & Automation Escrcpy 3.0.8 is the **first official public release of the 3.0 series**. This release focuses on three major directions: **intelligence, automation, and efficient device management**. It introduces the brand-new **Shortcut module** for faster device operations, enhances the file manager with **Quick Access**, adds **visual recognition-based automation judgment**, and introduces a new **MCP (Model Context Protocol)-based AI automation architecture**. In addition, this release brings significant improvements to keyboard and mouse mapping, preference management, AI Copilot experience, MCP stability, build infrastructure, and overall system reliability. aiSummary.oneLiner: A graphical interface for scrcpy enabling multi-device control and AI-assisted automation.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Escrcpy acts as an advanced graphical frontend for scrcpy, allowing users to display and control Android devices from their desktop. It extends basic mirroring by offering embedded windows that automatically fit screen resolutions and orientations. The tool supports simultaneous multi-device control, broadcasting inputs across devices, and facilitating batch operations like APK installations. It features a comprehensive keyboard mapping system for touch, joystick, and swipe inputs. Furthermore, it integrates an MCP-based AI Copilot to assist with intelligent device management and automated script orchestration.
keyFeatures: Inset mirroring: Provides a dedicated embedded window that automatically adjusts to the device's resolution and orientation.
Multi-device control: Enables simultaneous management of multiple Android devices within a single unified interface.
Keyboard mapping: Allows users to configure custom hotkeys for touch, swipe, joystick, and automated actions.
AI Copilot integration: Leverages an MCP-based AI assistant to intelligently interpret and execute device commands.
Visual automation: Supports step-by-step orchestration using screen image recognition for batch execution workflows.
